# Test fixtures

- `tos-speechband-10ms.u8`, `tos-en.srt`: from *Tears of Steel* (2012) © Blender Foundation,
  mango.blender.org, licensed under CC BY 3.0. The `.u8` file holds the film's speech-band
  (300–3000 Hz) level every 10 ms, one byte each (0.5 dB steps from −120 dB), not audio.
  Used to check subtitle sync against a real soundtrack with known-correct subtitles.
